say:2:1310728001:0.text: How do we cross the mountain? Do we have to climb down or something?
say:2:1310728001:0.source_cn: 我们要怎么翻越山脉呢？难道要徒手从这么高的山上爬下去？

say:3:1310728002:0.text: From what we've seen, I think the mine under the cliff leads to the ancient battlefield... We should head out from there.
say:3:1310728002:0.source_cn: 刚才你也看到了，山崖下的矿洞能通向古战场……我们应该可...

say:4:1310728003:0.text: So, all we have to do now is <style="highlight">find the entrance to the mine</style>.
say:4:1310728003:0.source_cn: 那么我们现在要做的，就是<style=highligh...

say:5:1310728004:0.text: Chippy hopes this mine won't collapse... Ow! Why did you just pinch me, Hammie?
say:5:1310728004:0.source_cn: 希望这个矿洞没有塌方……唔，漫漫你捂我的嘴干什么！

say:6:1310728005:0.text: Don't go borrowing trouble! Let's ask around and see if anyone knows where the entrance is.
say:6:1310728005:0.source_cn: 不许说不吉利的话！我们先去附近找人问问，说不定有人知道...
